whatItIs.statement: Displays rich content in a portal, triggered by a button.

whenToUse.statement: Use Popover when a trigger should reveal rich, interactive content without navigating away from the current context.

howToUse.statement: Compose Popover with PopoverTrigger and PopoverContent; PopoverHeader, PopoverTitle, and PopoverDescription can structure content inside the surface.
Use PopoverTrigger with asChild when an existing control such as Button should act as the trigger.

options.statement: Use the align prop on PopoverContent to control horizontal alignment.
Popover supports RTL layouts through the Radix-backed component and directional positioning props.
